title: 十三张竖屏牌桌背景
intendedUse: 竖屏设备上的十三张游戏场景，牌区和玩家状态由 PixiJS 绘制
prompt: Create a portrait-orientation dedicated Shisanshui game-table background viewed from a slightly elevated near-top-down angle. Use deep emerald felt, ink-teal shadows, a restrained warm-ivory/gold perimeter rail and polished stylized 3D casual-game materials. Keep the central vertical card-play area uninterrupted and low-contrast, with subtle peripheral regions for four player seats. This is the focused game interior, not the external multi-game portal. No people, cards, ranks, symbols, text, score marks or controls.
negativePrompt: bright portal lobby, archway scenery, casino photography, roulette, chips, dice, cash, people, cards, text, numbers, UI, clutter, center ornament, watermark

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match game-specific material and lighting; compose an independent vertical play surface.
